title: Harness contract v1: needs_input request
description: A decision request returned in a result block with status awaiting-human.

options.description: Choices offered. Empty for a free-form answer.

recommended.description: ID of the recommended option, or null when there is none.

context.description: Background the answerer needs: evidence, trade-offs, links to run artifacts.

blocking.description: false lets the harness continue other work and apply the recommended option after its configured timeout.

kind.description: What is asked: question (information or a choice), permission (approve or deny an action), decision (a choice the step may not take alone). Absent means decision.

risk.description: Risk of getting the answer wrong. Absent counts as not low: no automatic answer.
